_about: What a chart's form writes for each kind (frontend/src/lib/notes/editor/chartFormText.js), and how the engine reads it (engine/notes_charts.py): chartFormText.test.js writes each model and expects its block byte for byte, then reads it back; tests/test_notes_chart_fill.py draws each block and expects its kind and its lines.

forms.name: a timeline of three events and a period

rows.what: Giants Brigades on a peak of the Kahbub Mountains

forms.block:
::: chart
kind: timeline
| When | What happened | Until |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 18 Oct 2026 | Giants Brigades on a peak of the Kahbub Mountains | |
| Oct 2026 | The front moves north | |
| 10 Nov 2026 | Presence northeast of Huwayrib | 14 Nov 2026 |
| 2026 | The year of the offensive | |
:::

lines: 18 Oct 2026: Giants Brigades on a peak of the Kahbub Mountains
10 Nov 2026 to 14 Nov 2026: Presence northeast of Huwayrib
